content_json.title: Expectation Setting
bullets: Trust your instincts: the first thought that comes to your mind is likely correct. Avoid overthinking.
Focus on your natural self: our goal is to discover who you are naturally, not how you are in specific situations.
Think holistically: don't just focus on one aspect; consider your complete self.
Balanced perspective: when given options, remember that you possess both qualities. The focus is on understanding which side is more dominant in you.

content_json.title: Six Attitudes
content_json.caption: Based on Eduard Spranger, Types of Men (1928)

content_json.title: A.
bullets: I like objectivity in all areas of life.
I like identifying, differentiating, generalizing, systematizing.
I like pursuit of knowledge, identifying truth and untruth.
I like knowledge for the sake of knowing.
I hate inability to know, learn or discover.
I hate emotional, subjective experience without rational justification.

slides.notes: Don't name the attitude yet — participants read and see which resonates.

content_json.title: B.
bullets: I like appreciation of form, harmony and beauty.
I like enjoyment of all the senses.
I like understanding the feelings of myself and others.
I like self-realization, self-fulfillment and self-actualization.
I hate disturbances in form, beauty and harmony in myself, others and/or the environment.

content_json.title: C.
bullets: I like understanding the totality of life.
I like finding meaning in life.
I like pursuit of the divine in life.
I like following and dying for a cause.
I like living constantly according to a "closed" book.
I like converting others to my way of thinking.
I don't like people who oppose my beliefs.

content_json.title: D.
bullets: I like practicality in all areas of my life.
I like surpassing others in the attainment of wealth.
I like using resources to accomplish results.
I like gaining a measurable return on all my investments.
I like creative application of resources.
I like producing goods, materials, services & marketing them for economic gain.
I like maximizing or conserving resources.
I don't like to see wasted resources, time, materials and/or services.
I hate investments with inadequate or no return.

content_json.title: E.
bullets: I like generosity of time, talent and resources.
I like seeing and developing potential in others.
I like championing a worthy cause.
I hate decisions and actions which are insensitive to people's needs.

content_json.title: F.
bullets: I like advancing position and strategic alliances.
I like attaining and using power to accomplish purpose.
I like planning and carrying out a winning strategy.
I hate actual or perceived threat of diminished power or position.
I hate inability to advance, lack of opportunity for individual advancement.

columns.heading: A) The Theoretical Attitude
bullets: I use my intellect to systematically understand and discover the truth. The discovery of Truth and Knowledge is my main motivation in life. I seek knowledge for its own sake.

columns.heading: B) The Aesthetic Attitude
bullets: I enjoy and experience the beauty around me and find meaning and fulfilment within the experience of living. My main motivation is to experience the Inner Vision.

columns.heading: C) The Traditional Attitude
bullets: I pursue and understand the highest meaning of life within an established system of beliefs. My main motivation is to search and find the highest value in life.

columns.heading: D) The Utilitarian Attitude
bullets: I see most things in terms of their usefulness and practicality. My main motivation is to turn what I do and have into a useful purpose.

columns.heading: E) The Social Attitude
bullets: I enjoy helping others and believe that all decisions should be sensitive to people's needs. My main goal in life is to do what I can to eliminate hate and conflict in the world.

columns.heading: F) The Individualistic Attitude
bullets: I want to achieve the highest position possible and wield the greatest power in my chosen field and will do everything within my ability to reach these goals.
